'''Morningfire''' was a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who led [[Vornskr Company]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Company/Legends|company]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TUR" />

During the war, following the capture and [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of most the crew of a [[Unidentified Republic military exploration ship|Republic military exploration ship]] on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] Morningfire led the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of Vornskr Company on a [[Rescue on O'reen|rescue mission to O'reen]], which led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the planet's [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars rescue)|ruling Magnus]]. Due to the [[Magnus (title)|Magnus']] death, O'reen was eventually quarantined by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in an attempt to control the planet's population, and to stop it from sharing military secrets and resources to the Confederacy.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' thanks entirely to Rodney willing to give me a shot at doing some freelancer work for Star Wars Saga Edition, first for Galaxy at War and then again for Unknown Regions, where I got to add two entirely new planets to Star Wars lore as well as sneak in a reference to a Jedi General Morningfire, who for a time was indeed canon (low level canon, but canon all the same).|Jonathan Stevens, on the creation of Morningfire|<ref name="Dono's blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=jedimorningfire|url=2016/04/the-real-best-four-days-of-gaming-my.html|name=Dono's Gaming & Etc Blog|text=The REAL Best Four Days of Gaming - my thoughts on GamerNationCon 2016|date=2016-04-16}}</ref>}}
Morningfire was mentioned in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a hardcover supplement for the [[Saga Edition|''Star Wars Saga Edition'']] [[roleplaying game]], written by [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Rodney Thompson]], and [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="TUR" /> and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[April 20]], [[2010]].<ref name="TUR BTS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/UnknownRegions|text=''The Unknown Regions''}}</ref> Morningfire was created as a reference to freelance game designer [[Jonathan Stevens]]'<ref name="TUR" /> fan character and forum handle, Donovan Morningfire, making it one of the few [[List of fanon elements in continuity|fanon elements]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Dono's blog" />
